title: Sequence-aware trace sampler and burn-risk mapper pipeline
creator: Elena Martinez
description: Build a sequence-aware trace sampling layer and a burn-risk mapping pipeline that links sampled spans to SLO burn-rate signals. Goal is to reduce trace ingestion cost while improving the fidelity of burn-rate alert attribution so on-call can rapidly identify root causes. The work touches tracing hooks in the runtime (sampling decisions), the metrics/logs pipeline (enrichment and join keys), the alerting service (burn-rate attribution API), and dashboards/runbooks. Implementation will favor a deterministic, rolling-window sampler that increases retention for sequences that show early latency degradation or error spikes, plus a lightweight mapper that attributes token-level / route-level burn to trace clusters. Deliverables: sampler integration in proxy runtime, Kafka enrichment topic, mapper microservice, Grafana dashboards and an updated on-call playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Sampler applied at runtime reduces trace ingestion volume for steady-state traffic by >= 40% vs baseline while keeping recall of burn-causing sequences >= 90%
Burn-risk mapper returns a stable attribution link for >= 90% of burn-rate alerts within 30s of alert firing
Grafana dashboard shows per-route/top-span contributors to SLO burn with 24h/7d views and drilldown links to raw traces
Pager policy integration routes high-confidence burn attributions directly to Tier-1 on-call; runbook updated and reviewed by SRE
E2E tests and load tests demonstrate pipeline handles 200k traces/day and 1k burn attribution queries per minute without tail latency degradation
